$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no SUCU schema (its suco-v1.json models the different TADIR object type SUCO, authorization default variant). The document maps the cross-client authorization group key (TBRG_AUTH-BRGRU + TBRG_AUTH-OBJECT) and its language-dependent texts (TBRG_AUTHT); the SAP object is the 40-character TADIR composite <BRGRU padded to 30><OBJECT padded to 10>. Header.description is the text of the original language, texts[] carries the other TBRG_AUTHT rows.
title: Authorization Group
description: Authorization group (transaction SU21 / tables TBRG_AUTH + TBRG_AUTHT)

description.title: Description
description.description: Group text of the original language (TBRG_AUTHT-BEZEI), at most 40 characters

originalLanguage.title: Original Language
originalLanguage.description: Two-letter ISO language code of the original language (TADIR-MASTERLANG via T002-LAISO)

authorizationGroup.title: Authorization Group Name
authorizationGroup.description: TBRG_AUTH-BRGRU (CHAR 30): group name, may be namespaced (/NS/NAME)

authorizationObject.title: Authorization Object
authorizationObject.description: TBRG_AUTH-OBJECT (CHAR 10, check table TOBJ): the authorization object the group belongs to

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: TBRG_AUTHT texts of the languages other than header.originalLanguage

language.title: Language
language.description: Two-letter ISO language code (TBRG_AUTHT-SPRAS via T002-LAISO)
